problem_text: Find the number of functions π mapping the set A = {1,2,3,4,5,6} onto A such that for every a in A, π(π(π(π(π(π(a)))))) = a (i.e., the sixth iterate of π is the identity).
notes: Cycles must have lengths dividing 6 (1,2,3,6). Eight partition types: 120+40+15+1+40+15+45+120=396. Verified by brute-force enumeration of all 720 permutations of {1..6}.
